name: print-social-academy-course-promo-post-grid-violet
title: Tech-academy course promo grid in violet with lime highlights
whatItIs: A black presentation board with a 3x3 grid of promo posts for a coding academy. Violet and lavender cards hold bold sans headlines, lime label bars, laptop and clock photos, and UI screenshots.
whatItMeans: Dynamic and modern; violet and lime feel like a tech bootcamp.
techniques: Combine violet backgrounds with lime label bars.
Mix stock photos with UI screenshots as backdrops.
Use varying crops and layouts inside one palette.
Present the set on black so the colours glow.

vocabulary.definition: A coloured strip behind a line of text.
Using UI images as background texture.
Sticking to the same colours across a set.
An overview of all posts in a campaign.
